outcome.technical: Measured: payload 199998 bytes on posix at the CI SHA f9849e9b and HEAD 045c821f; fields 189943 of it (config 25194, manifest 164723). Platform difference found: guide_card()'s 'file' was os.path.join('agents', name), serialised as agents\\guide.md on Windows (+1 byte, reproduced by the backslash os.sep simulation: 199999). CRLF ruled out: .gitattributes forces LF and a CRLF copy of schema/ and agents/ measured 199998 identically. The other 2 bytes of the CI 200001 were not reproduced by any simulation. The drawer never reads payload.fields (help-drawer.js only reads composition/topics/agent/schemas and asks /api/help?doc=&path= per field), but tools/ui-checks/stage-tabs.mjs uses payload.fields.config.trivialLineThreshold as an oracle. Duplication: one $def mounted at several paths was expanded at each (proposals[].payload.phase re-expanded the whole phase shape, about 57 KB; bugs[].ado, tasks testEvidence/ado, policy.agents/mcp copying policy.skills). Fix in _help.py: _walk_schema records $def mount sites; fold_repeats drops a later mount's subtree when it equals the first (comparison ignores topic, includes default) and records an alias; unalias/lookup(aliases)/entry_for resolve through it; payload gains an 'aliases' key; the agent card file is 'agents/' + name. Payload now 133604 bytes, 66396 under the cap, headroom 26396 above the 40000 owed. Tests: p5 replaced by the clause case (native, CRLF-root and backslash-os builds must be equal and <= cap - headroom); fo1-fo5 added (no-loss over every full-table path, equal mount folds, differing default does not, chained alias, canonical key named); p1 key set updated. Mutation probes in a scratch copy: always-fold -> fo3 red; lookup ignoring aliases -> fo1,fo5; single-pass unalias -> fo1,fo4; os.path.join file -> p5; no fold -> fo1,fo2,fo5,p5. test__help 110/110 exit 0; full sweep exit 0 (335/335 files, 16452 cases); cp1252 sweep exit 0 (335/335); ruff and vermin clean on both files.
outcome.descriptive: The help payload is a third smaller, measures the same on every platform, and keeps 40 KB of free headroom under its cap.
